records.context: Frames from ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif``, full masks from the silver segmentation ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif`` relabelled by the tracking markers ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). A frame missing any of the three is skipped, and a pair is only formed from two consecutive frame numbers. Slice-mask filenames are ignored and duplicate frame numbers are rejected. With ``segmentation='GT'``, full masks are read from ``<seq>_GT/SEG``. A source whose next-frame marker lacks an unambiguous full mask is censored for that pair, rather than labelled as a disappearance.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.ctc_pairs#1
records.source: Frames from ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif``, full masks from the silver segmentation ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif`` relabelled by the tracking markers ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). A frame missing any of the three is skipped, and a pair is only formed from two consecutive frame numbers. Slice-mask filenames are ignored and duplicate frame numbers are rejected. With ``segmentation='GT'``, full masks are read from ``<seq>_GT/SEG``. A source whose next-frame marker lacks an unambiguous full mask is censored for that pair, rather than labelled as a disappearance.
records.translation: Fotogramas de ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif``, máscaras completas de la segmentación silver ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif`` reetiquetadas mediante los marcadores de seguimiento ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). Se omite un fotograma si falta cualquiera de las tres entradas y solo se forma un par con dos números de fotograma consecutivos. Se ignoran los nombres de archivo de máscaras de cortes y se rechazan los números de fotograma duplicados. Con ``segmentation='GT'``, las máscaras completas se leen de ``<seq>_GT/SEG``. Un origen cuyo marcador del siguiente fotograma no tiene una máscara completa inequívoca se excluye de ese par, en lugar de etiquetarse como desaparición.

records.context: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already paid for, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#1
records.source: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already paid for, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.translation: Entrenamiento en dos etapas: la segmentación de la red base ya está aprendida, por lo que se congela mientras aprende la nueva cabeza y después se entrena todo con una tasa de aprendizaje baja. Ambos fotogramas de cada par reciben los mismos aumentos de datos antes de calcular sus objetivos.

records.context: A training extracted image region keeps supervision only for complete source masks and, when present in the full target frame, complete successor masks. A successor outside the tile is not a disappearance. Absences in the supplied full-frame labels remain supervised; this does not validate those annotations. Unusable extracted image regions are retried up to 32 times per step. Censoring prevents incorrect targets at extracted image region boundaries but removes some fast-motion examples; it does not establish full-motion accuracy.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#2
records.source: A training crop keeps supervision only for complete source masks and, when present in the full target frame, complete successor masks. A successor outside the tile is not a disappearance. Absences in the supplied full-frame labels remain supervised; this does not validate those annotations. Unusable crops are retried up to 32 times per step. Censoring prevents incorrect targets at crop boundaries but removes some fast-motion examples; it does not establish full-motion accuracy.
records.translation: Un recorte de entrenamiento conserva supervisión solo para máscaras de origen completas y, cuando están presentes en el fotograma de destino completo, máscaras completas de sucesores. Un sucesor fuera del bloque recortado no es una desaparición. Las ausencias en las etiquetas de fotogramas completos proporcionadas siguen supervisándose; esto no valida esas anotaciones. Se vuelve a intentar el muestreo de recortes inutilizables hasta 32 veces por paso. La exclusión evita objetivos incorrectos en los bordes del recorte, pero elimina algunos ejemplos de movimiento rápido; no demuestra exactitud en todo el intervalo de movimientos.
